company.name: Betterhalf
company.shortDescription: Betterhalf is India’s first and only marriage super app for urban Indians. It's like Match.com for 100M Indians
company.description:
Uniquely positioned as a new age matrimony platform, Betterhalf envisions to build a super app of Indian matrimony and full stack wedding services as company's growth pillars. 

Founded by Pawan Gupta and Rahul Namdev, Betterhalf recently raised Series A backed by FinSight Ventures (Ex Bumble investor)  & other marquee investors including Mike Krieger, Co-founder of Instagram; Arash Ferdowsi, Co-Founder of Dropbox and many others.

productsAndServices.description: A matchmaking platform designed for urban Indians to find marriage partners through a digital app interface.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Undisclosed round raised $10,000, or 0.09% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,188,578 to $47,737,035, a 9.2x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 26 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
